meta.name: The Yoga of Devotion
meta.outline: Verses 1–7: is it better to worship Krishna in a form, or the formless? Both reach him, but the first way is easier; 8–12: four steps, from fixing the mind on him down to giving up the results of action; 13–20: the qualities of the devotee who is dear to Krishna.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
words: the devotees who are always united with you in this way
and those who worship the imperishable, the unseen
which of them know yoga best
verses.tr: Arjuna asked: Some devotees worship you, always united with you in this way. Others worship the imperishable and unseen. Which of them know yoga best?

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते
words: those who worship me, always united with me
I consider them the best in yoga
verses.tr: Krishna said: Those who fix their minds on me and worship me, always united with me and full of the highest faith, I consider the best in yoga.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: But those who worship the imperishable, which cannot be defined or seen, which is everywhere and beyond thought, unchanging, unmoving and constant,

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: delighting in the good of all beings
verses.tr: who control all their senses, are even-minded everywhere and delight in the good of all beings: they too reach me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the difficulty is greater for those
whose minds are set on the unseen
for the path of the unseen
is hard for those with a body to reach
verses.tr: The difficulty is greater for those whose minds are set on the unseen, for the path of the unseen is hard for people who live in a body.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः
words: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य
but those who give up all their actions to me
with a yoga that has no other object
verses.tr: But those who offer all their actions to me, hold me as their highest goal, and worship me, meditating on me with undivided yoga,

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: I become the one who lifts them out
of the ocean of death and rebirth
whose minds are fixed on me
verses.tr: whose minds are fixed on me: I soon lift them out of the ocean of death and rebirth, Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय
निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः
words: fix your mind on me alone
let your intellect rest in me
you will live in me alone
verses.tr: Fix your mind on me alone and let your understanding rest in me. From then on you will live in me. There is no doubt of this.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम्
words: if you cannot fix your mind
by the yoga of regular practice
verses.tr: If you cannot fix your mind steadily on me, Arjuna, then seek to reach me through regular practice.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: if you are not able to practise either
be devoted to working for me
even by doing actions for my sake
verses.tr: If you are not able to practise either, then devote yourself to working for me. Even by doing actions for my sake, you will reach perfection.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: अथ एतत् अपि अशक्तः असि कर्तुम्
if you cannot do even this
taking refuge in union with me
then give up the results of all your actions
verses.tr: If you cannot do even this, then take refuge in me and, with self-control, give up the results of all your actions.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: giving up the results of action is better than meditation
from giving up, peace follows at once
verses.tr: Knowledge is better than mere practice, and meditation is better than knowledge. Giving up the results of action is better than meditation, for peace follows at once from giving up.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च
words: the same in pain and pleasure
verses.tr: One who hates no being, who is friendly and kind, free from the sense of “I” and “mine”, the same in pain and pleasure, and forgiving;

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: with mind and intellect given to me
that devotee of mine is dear to me
verses.tr: who is always content, a self-controlled yogi, firm in resolve, with mind and understanding given to me: that devotee of mine is dear to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः
words: by whom the world is not disturbed
and who is not disturbed by the world
free from excitement, envy, fear and worry
that person is dear to me
verses.tr: One who does not disturb the world and is not disturbed by the world, who is free from excitement, envy, fear and worry: that person is dear to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः
words: who has given up all selfish undertakings
that devotee of mine is dear to me
verses.tr: One who expects nothing, who is pure, capable, impartial and free from anxiety, and who has given up all selfish undertakings: that devotee of mine is dear to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति
words: who has let go of good and bad alike
who is full of devotion: that person is dear to me
verses.tr: One who neither rejoices nor hates, neither grieves nor craves, who has let go of both good and bad fortune and is full of devotion: that person is dear to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः
words: the same to enemy and friend
the same in cold and heat, pleasure and pain
verses.tr: One who is the same to enemy and friend, in honour and insult, in cold and heat, in pleasure and pain, and who is free from attachment;

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: to whom blame and praise are equal
full of devotion: that person is dear to me
verses.tr: to whom blame and praise are equal, who is quiet, content with whatever comes, not tied to any home, steady in mind and full of devotion: that person is dear to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: but those who, this nectar of dharma
follow as I have taught it
those devotees are very dear to me
verses.tr: But those who follow this nectar of dharma as I have taught it, full of faith and holding me as their highest goal: those devotees are very dear to me.
